subject: english
question:
Choose the option which best expresses the meaning of the given idiom.

By fair means or foul

options.text: To find difficulty in completing some work
To get one’s way with honesty or dishonesty

solution: The correct answer is: **To get one’s way with honesty or dishonesty.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The idiom **"By fair means or foul"** means achieving something by any possible method, whether it is honest or dishonest. (ईमानदारी या बेईमानी से किसी चीज को प्राप्त करना) • **Example:** He was determined to win the competition by fair means or foul. • **"To get one’s way with honesty or dishonesty"** refers to someone who is willing to use any method, fair or unfair, to achieve their goal. (ईमानदारी या बेईमानी से अपनी राह बनाना) • **Example:** She managed to get the promotion by fair means or foul. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.** 31:T961, The correct answer is: **Kanu prefer.**
